context: A teacher and student discuss tech and nature
purpose: Teach: アルゴリズム/ベビー/プリンタ/木々/鳩/泳い/峠/トス

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、AIアルゴリズムと家庭応用、面白い切り口ですね。
lines.en: Ren, your paper on AI algorithms and household applications — that's a really fresh angle.
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Leans forward slightly. Genuine interest in the specifics. Measured pace, no rush. Teacher-to-student ease.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ベビーモニターやプリンタ連携、章として扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at baby monitors and printer integration as separate chapters.
lines.style: Careful, earnest. Eyes up briefly to meet hers. Slight hesitation before details — wanting to get it right. Steady voice, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自然描写の章、近所の木々と鳩の観察、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your nature-observation chapter was really thoughtful — the trees and pigeons you documented, the care you took with it.
lines.style: Softer now, more personal. Nod of recognition. Slowing slightly, as if lingering on something she noticed. Warm but not patronising.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夏、川で泳いだ際、観察記録もとっていました。
lines.en: During the summer, when I was swimming in the river, I kept observation notes even then.
lines.style: Quieter, almost confessional. Slight self-consciousness — showing how far the project went. Soft delivery, like admitting something genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 峠越えの旅程、最終章のレポート、印象的でした。
lines.en: And that final chapter, the mountain-pass journey — the report you wrote about it was really striking.
lines.style: Gentle emphasis on 'striking'. Leaning back slightly, reflective. Taking a moment to acknowledge what impressed her. Warm recognition.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: バレーボール部の遠征中、合間にトス練習も、合わせて書きました。
lines.en: During the volleyball team's trip, I even wrote about the time I spent doing toss drills between matches.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost playful. Small smile in the voice. The energy shifts — he's showing how completely he committed. Warm close without losing earnestness.
